intro: Devaa Nee Sannidhilone is the latest Telugu Christian worship song written, tuned and music composed by Symonpeter Chevuri and sung by D Preethi David. The official music video was released on July 05, 2025, through her official YouTube channel, Ravi Mandadi, inviting hearts into a deeper worship experience.
